text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The cool breeze blowing from the pond 
feels wonderful... I wonder where this 
wind is flowing from?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm, in that forest over there?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Zephyr-san! Excuse me, I have a 
fan letter for— ...Aand she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, I keep missing my chance... 
...No, today's the day!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
As the altitude rises, it gets cooler, 
doesn't it? And not just that... it feels 
as though the air carries the essence of 
nature-rich lands—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah.... Zephyr-sa――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Daruma, Mr. Orange, full of energy 
today as well, I see. Me? I came to find 
the headwaters of the wind.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Zeph—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...This feeling... It feels like we're 
getting closer and closer."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so scary...! Wait for me, 
Zephyr-saaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I found it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"That cool breeze carries not just the 
pond, but also the water flowing from this 
mountain stream, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*, *pant*... Z-Zephyr-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I felt a gentle breeze blowing 
continuously from behind, and it turns out 
to be you. Did you need something from 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I became a fan of yours after seeing you 
run the other day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
At first, she seemed so fluffy and airy 
that I thought she was kind of like me, 
but once she ran, she was as fast as the 
rushing wind—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just thought it was so cool! Besides, 
even someone slow and clumsy like me... I 
wondered if I could become like you, 
Zephyr-san...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So, um, what I'm trying to say is... Er, 
please accept this fan letter if you'd 
like!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —So, that's what happened.
choice_data_list: What did the fan letter say?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Well... it turns out they forgot to 
include the all-important letter."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"However, from the potpourri in the 
envelope and her own wind, her feelings 
came through loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The person who praised my wind as cool... 
said they will continue coming to cheer me 
on."
choice_data_list: Let's bring a cool breeze with us!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having voiced her determination, Yamanin 
Zephyr looked more dignified and gallant 
than ever.
